description: Use when an agent needs a US company's latest SEC filings. Returns the most recent EDGAR filings for a ticker, optionally one form type (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, S-1, 13F-HR), with filing date, report date, accession number, description, 8-K item codes and links to the document and the filing index. Source: SEC EDGAR public filings. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

ticker.description: a US-listed ticker, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK-B

name: get_sec_filings

data.description: the get_sec_filings payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_sec_filings

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: SEC filings
